entities.summary: Robert V. Kehoe was an American soccer player who played as a defender. He earned four caps as captain of the U.S. national team in 1965. He later coached the U.S. He was also the first U.S. born coach in the North American Soccer League. He was inducted into the National Soccer Hall of Fame in 1989.
